title: The True Horror: Fogbound
description: "You are not alone in the fog. Face sound-reactive entities and haunting shadows in this minimalist 1.20.1 Forge horror experience."
body:
## 🌫️ **The True Horror: Fogbound**
**"Can you survive the mist?"**
**TTHF** is not just an ordinary horror modpack; it is an atmospheric survival experience. Within the dense fog that shrouds the world, unknown creatures await you. You will grow more tense with every step and startle at every sound.
### 🌑 **Key Features:**
 * **Realistic Atmosphere:** Advanced fog mechanics that restrict your field of vision and create a claustrophobic feel.
 * **Advanced Horror:** A structure that immerses the player not only through visuals but also through haunting sound design.
 * **Optimized Performance:** Special settings for a smooth experience even on lower-end systems.
 * **Challenging Survival:** Resources are scarce; the night is darker and more dangerous.
### 🛠️ **Community and Support:**
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join our community and become part of the development process!
🎮 **Our Discord Server:** https://discord.gg/63Rhdbjpjz
*(Don't forget to use our forum channel for bug reports and suggestions!)*
**A Developer Note by Kaelon**
*This modpack is constantly being updated with new horror elements.*
